mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; dolutegravir has minimal enzyme inhibition but may cause modest increases in tolterodine exposure through weak CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: No dose adjustment typically required; monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and adjust tolterodine dose if needed.
